name: 14 Pally Udayan Sangha
description:
One of the best puja & Nice puja pandal and the idol of Goddess Durga is very beautiful. A famous puja pandal of 14 pally udayan sangha.....

Nice decoration fully lightings all areas in the pandal, it is one of the most beautiful and famous pandals of Durga Puja.....

name: DAKSHIN ENTALLY SARBAJANIN DURGA PUJA COMMITTEE.
description: A very old Durga Puja Celebrated here almost for 70 years and still going on

name: 20 Pally Sarbojanin Durgotsav
description: Peaceful neighbourhood. Nice ambience for a Durga Puja. Known for its innovative pandal and idol. A lot of detailing in the inner as well as outer decoration of the pandal. The idol is very life like. The volunteers are very helpful and caring. Located on CIT Road. Convenient location. Options galore for the foodie. Various transport options are an added bonus.

name: Taltala Children Park
description: Popularly known as taltala children park. A small playground and a small park is there. Here you can play football or Cricket or badminton or volly . Club Football matches are organised here . A rest area is there . Children friendly atmosphere. Toilets are not available here. Located just beside the primary health centre taltala, Kolkata municipality. Parking lots are not available.

name: New Market Sarbojonin Sri Sri Durga Puja
description:
This year I saw an amazing idol,don't miss this one and 54 pally near Chaplin cinema.
These both are to be seen to have great idols each year.

name: Beliaghata 33 No. Palli Basi Brinda
description:
Beliaghata 33 Pally Durga Puja is known for its creative and meaningful theme-based pandals.

I have been visiting rhis pandal since they dis a taxi based theme.

Every year, the club presents thoughtful concepts with strong artistic execution, making it a notable stop for pandal hoppers in Kolkata.

Other than Durga Puja, their Saraswati puja is also very nice

name: Sandhani Club Puja Mandap
description: Beleghata Sandhani Club truly delivers one of the most memorable Durga Pujas in the city. The pandal design is always innovative and beautifully executed, with great attention to detail that makes it stand out from the crowd. The idol of Maa Durga is majestic and divine, radiating positive energy the moment you step inside.

name: Nabamilan Durga Puja Pandal
description:
1. Small theme based durga puja with small budget
2. Located in the Beleghata area
3. Mostly for local residents
4. Attracts a lot of crowd due to its close location of 33 Pally

name: Durga Puja - by Kishore Sangha Club
Tangra Gholpara Durga Puja
description: The most popular Durga Puja Mandap in Tangra. Every year it comes out with unique and innovative theme, it draws hundred of thousands of people towards it's pandal. In past it has been accorded with numbers of honour from some well known organisations.

name: Tangra Hari Sabha Math Durga Puja
description: This year beside this exact location another Durga Puja has taken place very beautifully and in an innovative way Near Devendra Chandra Dey Road.

name: Park Circus Beniapukur United Puja Committee
description:
One of the big Pujo’s of central Kolkata, this Pujo has a lot of space to construct a huge Pandal.
They’ve installed the biggest chandelier that I’ve seen within a non permanent structure ever.
